name: trustlance
description: Portable reputation & milestone-escrow platform for freelancers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @trustlance/api" "npm run dev -w @trustlance/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trustlance/shared-types && npm run build -w @trustlance/api && npm run build -w @trustlance/web

overridesReason: Transitive security patches. npm audit's suggested 'fix' for the postcss and sharp advisories is downgrading Next to 9.3.3, which is worse than the vulnerabilities. These pin patched versions inside Next's tree instead. brace-expansion is pinned per-major (patched in 1.1.12 and 2.0.2) rather than forced to v5 — minimatch v3 calls the v1 API and a blanket v5 override breaks ESLint with 'expand is not a function'. Re-check on each Next upgrade and drop any Next has caught up to.
